title: 0xMemory
message: Commit-aware persistent memory for AI coding agents
bullets: Team 9 · Final-year prototype
Preserve project decisions across conversations
Review changed evidence before returning old advice
notes: Introduce actual team members and institution verbally; add their names before submission. State the contribution as lifecycle management, not invention of persistent memory.

title: The problem
message: A remembered decision can become outdated.
bullets: A new conversation loses the rationale behind a design choice.
Saved context can outlive the implementation that supported it.
Semantic similarity alone does not establish current truth.
notes: Use JSON-to-SQLite as the concrete example. Distinguish lost context from outdated context.

title: Our objective
message: Return current decisions with inspectable evidence.
bullets: Project-scoped memory with IDs and commit links
Explicit observation, verification, and replacement
History preserved for audit and explanation
MCP tools available to coding agents
notes: Observation is explicit. Do not claim a background watcher or autonomous truth checker.

title: Architecture
message: Agent → MCP → MemoryStore → evidence and retrieval
bullets: Markdown: authoritative memories and revision history
ChromaDB + Sentence Transformer: local semantic index
Git: file-change and commit-order evidence
CLI/dashboard: inspection; MCP stdio: editor integration
notes: The engine executable and application root are separate. Each application owns its .0xmemory directory. Use the diagram in FINAL_REPORT for a detailed architecture view.

title: Memory lifecycle
bullets: Remember a decision and its supporting file/commit.
Observe a committed code change.
Review the evidence: retain the statement or replace it.
Normal recall excludes stale and superseded entries.
notes: A file change does not prove the statement false. Still-valid decisions use verify; changed decisions use supersede.

title: A real editor demonstration
message: Dodo task storage changed from JSON to SQLite.
bullets: Copilot saved the JSON rationale and recalled it in another chat.
The migration was tested and committed locally.
Observation marked the old decision stale.
After review, a fresh chat recalled the SQLite replacement.
notes: This is the developer-reported Copilot case study. Show expanded tool calls from the actual run if available. Do not invent screenshots or claim Cursor/Antigravity testing.

title: Controlled experiment A
message: Same ranking; only lifecycle eligibility differs.
bullets: 30 synthetic Git-backed scenarios: 5 development + 25 reserved
Changed decisions, unrelated edits, valid refactors, replacements, no-answer cases
Real embeddings and Git transitions
Basic: filtering disabled; lifecycle: active memories only
notes: This is an ablation, not a comparison against a different historical search implementation. Labels are assistant-authored and need human review.

title: Outdated context was excluded
bullets: Reserved partition: 25 scenarios, 30 checkpoints
Clean replacement retrieval: 0/5 → 5/5
Unrelated-change preservation: 5/5 in both variants
Each result includes IDs, status, scores, commits, and labels
notes: These are small synthetic counts, not general accuracy percentages. The 12 applicable checkpoints are seven changed decisions and five replacements.

title: Filtering has a cost
bullets: Five changed files still supported their original decisions.
Those true memories were withheld pending review.
All five were retrieved after explicit verification.
Truth labels were kept independent of lifecycle state.
notes: Explain the denominator: twenty answerable checkpoints, five withheld. This tradeoff is reported rather than hidden by relabelling stale memories irrelevant.

title: The no-answer weakness
message: Active does not necessarily mean relevant.
bullets: Both baseline variants returned content in all ten unanswered checkpoints.
Nearest neighbors can be unrelated or lack the requested detail.
The experiment measures context retrieval, not LLM hallucinations.
notes: Separate outdated retrieval from semantic relevance. A current statement about backup timing does not answer who approved the policy.

title: Controlled experiment B
message: Calibrate a relevance gate, then freeze it.
bullets: 24 new questions: 8 development + 16 reserved
Balanced answerable and unanswered cases
Cosine cutoff selected only on development data
Threshold 0.25; full grid and selection rule preserved
notes: The policy minimizes twice the missed-answer rate plus no-answer false positives, with lower-threshold tie breaking. Cosine is not a probability of correctness.

title: A negative result we kept
bullets: Development no-answer false positives: 4/4 → 2/4
Reserved no-answer false positives: 8/8 → 8/8
Reserved valid answers retained: 8/8
Gate implemented but experimental and disabled by default
notes: Do not present this as a solved feature. Topic-related statements can omit requested ownership, rationale, budget, or contract details.

title: Reproducibility and validation
message: Code, fixtures, raw outputs, and setup are documented.
bullets: Fresh-clone guide and reusable JSON Dodo starter
Real model/index checks fail rather than silently use a proxy
Unit, lifecycle, API, embedding, and MCP transport tests
Reports preserve failures and explicit test denominators
notes: Refer to INTEGRATION_STATUS for the current exact test count and restricted-session native-pipe exclusion. The original normal-terminal suite passed 79 tests before additions.

title: Limits and future work
message: A working prototype with clear boundaries.
bullets: Explicit observation and supplied review assertions
Single writer per project; no automatic contradiction proof
Small synthetic corpora and pending independent label review
Next: answerability-aware retrieval and matched-model coding tasks
notes: Independent teammate replication and other editor UI tests remain open. Future changes need a new reserved dataset because current results have been inspected.

title: Project outcome
message: Persistent decisions with auditable change management
bullets: Cross-session Copilot demonstration completed as reported
Lifecycle filtering behaved as designed in controlled fixtures
Review-delay and relevance failures measured openly
Report, runnable experiments, demo script, and setup guide included
notes: Conclude with the specific delivered contribution. Invite questions about evidence handling and evaluation design rather than claiming universal superiority.
